calls.title: Renewals / Expansion in HubSpot
calls.summary: The meeting centered on building a unified renewal dashboard, as proposed by Cary Rakin, to consolidate all renewals, forecasted revenue, and potential churn. It was emphasized that the dashboard should differentiate between close and renewal dates for accurate forecasting. Cary introduced the metric 'ATR' synonymous with ARR, focusing on revenue at renewal, while Ryan McGurk highlighted the need for improved visibility into baseline renewal revenue and increments for assessing net retention. The team acknowledged existing limitations in HubSpot regarding historical data and workflows, and it was agreed that mandatory contract attachments would enhance renewal compliance. Furthermore, the discussion included the implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and the establishment of new field values for better data governance in renewal tracking.
calls.keywords: Renewals, Forecasting, HubSpot, Contracts, ARR, Dashboard
